hypothesis: The image payload class owns a material share of the session-open wall on this fixture, through one or more of: the JSONL parse of 8.4MB of base64, the retained-window wire, the entry fold processing megabyte strings, or the TUI render path processing giant base64 payloads (the first-pack + image-component work). Decompose the open on BOTH paths (the agents-view attach path AND the plain session open) with per-phase spans (parse, wire, entry fold, layout/first-pack, first frame) and let the hot path decide which of the three candidate cuts — (a) render-path base64 skipping, (b) compaction-time image stripping, (c) persistence-by-reference — buys the goal.

(3) THE RIG: one lane-private VM (okxu4hbky33owc4o9utvo5m4, ubuntu:22.04 16c/32GB, rustup 1.98.1, release), the tip binary 612ba0f74bee + a probe binary 730094977345 carrying an env-gated phase instrument (PRIME_AGENT_IO_TRACE; pa-types io_trace module; ~34 unique-anchor patch sites: pa-core window open/scan/ctx, the daemon store open_windowed [scan/rows/window-build], worker create persist, worker handle_attach [summary/messages/build], the supervisor saved-session roster scan per-file [name/ms/bytes], the TUI open/create/attach/wire-msgs/fold/roster/hb/bash/stats/rebuild/frame/compose/layout marks) — sha-differ asserted; a raw-pty 120x40 driver (sync-frame accounting, needle walls, worker-socket grid, /proc RSS sampling, fresh fixture copy per trial with pre/post sha) driving the FULL production path (supervisor + live worker + TUI) offline; legs: the plain --resume open AND bare --resume -> agents view (the roster catalog scan) -> ENTER attach; 34 trials across the arms/legs + a 10-trial cold-page-cache block (sync + drop_caches per trial); fsync+fresh probes at every block boundary (advisory v1.0).
parity_notes: MEASUREMENT-ONLY LANE: no product change, no PR, the probe tree never ships; the instrument is env-gated and the tip-vs-probe needle bands overlap (the A/A control). THE TS ANCHORS (for any future image-path cut): TS tool-execution.ts (TS @ cd1f215) builds one Image component per image result block with fallbackOnly:true and the '\u{2570}\u{2500} ' prefix and HOLDS the base64 in the component; the Image constructor (tui/src/components/image.ts) eagerly parses getImageDimensions from the full base64; the fullscreen compose forces the textual fallback (withFullscreenImageFallback) — the port mirrors all of it byte-for-byte (image_component.rs + tool_card image_rows), so a render-path base64 SKIP would be a TS DIVERGENCE (TS holds and parses the payload) for the measured ~4ms of visible-tail parses; conversation-components.ts :194 passes includeImageDimensions:false on replay-path tool options. THE FROZEN-SURFACE MAP for the three options: (a) render-skip touches TUI output bytes only in graphics-capable inline placements (the metadata fallback row renders from dimensions, not the payload) — a divergence per the TS anchor above; (b) compaction-strip touches compaction content (frozen surface: compaction content parity + the TS anchor: TS compaction does NOT strip image payloads today) — a protocol-shape change needing its own TS-parity case; (c) persistence-by-reference touches the session-JSONL content itself (THE load-bearing frozen surface: session-JSONL replay + compaction content) plus the resend contract (the inline base64 exists for resend) — the biggest change, re-proving both contracts with oracles.

key_findings.1_where_the_22_9mb_goes: The open of Kevin's image-heavy session is ~0.4-0.6s at the tip and the image payload owns ~6ms of it: the cold backward scan parses the WHOLE file as metadata (the 8.35MB of base64 is scanned, never materialized) at 41ms, the second sidecar-warm open (the model restore's own open_windowed) adds ~33ms, the creation-prefix append+fdatasync is 6-97ms (regime), the worker boot ~100ms and the create tail ~140-240ms are the known create-wall class, the full-ship wire (1,387 messages, 2.9MB, image-free) is ~30ms, the fold is 1.1ms, the first frame 7ms (the sparse window packs only the visible rows — the 1,231-entry count pass does not run at open).
key_findings.2_the_image_share_is_bounded_everywhere: Pre-boundary (Kevin's fixture): ~4ms scan + ~1.8ms roster fold. In-window (the real earlier state): ~27ms phase-summed (wire +9.8, retained re-parse +6.8, scan +5.8, sidecar re-read +3.7, fold +0.8, frame +0.5 with a +23ms p90 tail on the visible-image dimension parses). Cold page cache: no measurable change on this VM class; the slower-disk bound is the 8.35MB read at bandwidth.
key_findings.3_none_of_the_three_options_buys_the_goa: (a) render-path skipping: a TS divergence (TS holds + eagerly parses the base64 in the Image component — verified at cd1f215) buying ~4ms of visible-tail parses at open (the count pass does not run at open); (b) compaction-time stripping: the natural window cut ALREADY strips images from the retained window on this very fixture (all 79 rows pre-boundary) — the mechanism the Codex shape would formalize is already in effect, and its measurable upside is the in-window class's ~27ms; (c) persistence-by-reference: the biggest change (the session-JSONL replay + resend contracts re-proven, the frozen surface is the JSONL itself) buying ~6ms on Kevin's fixture's open (~27ms on the in-window class) plus the file-size/cold-read bound.
key_findings.4_the_residual_wall_is_the_create_wall: The open's wall is image-independent and belongs to the create-wall class (the hc2 territory, the attach-paint ruling's residual): worker boot ~100ms + the DOUBLE/TRIPLE windowed open (the create's open_windowed + the model restore's own open_windowed + a third partial sidecar open) + the fdatasync persist regime (6-97ms) + the ~140-240ms unmarked create tail. The 21s retained-transcript class from the 2026-09-26 audit is GONE at this tip (1,387 messages fold in 1.1ms; the sparse render packs the visible window only).

honest_negative: The image payload is NOT the open wall at the tip, on either path, warm or cold: Kevin's real session opens in ~0.4-0.6s and the images cost ~6ms of it. All three candidate cuts target the wrong metric on this fixture; the lane records the bounded image shares (the differentials above), the TS anchors for any future image-path work, and routes the residual wall to its owner (the create-wall class). No product change, no PR.
reported_only_findings_and_followups: THE CREATE-WALL RESIDUAL (the hc2 territory): worker boot ~100ms + the double/triple windowed open at resume (the model restore's own open_windowed re-reads the retained suffix a second time — a merge/reuse candidate) + the 6-97ms fdatasync persist regime + the ~140-240ms unmarked create tail (engine/settings/catalog post-persist) — that is where Kevin's open wall lives

THE IN-WINDOW RENDER SHARE ON SCROLL/REBUILD (not open): the layout count pass processes every image entry (an ImageComponent + a dimensions parse per block, ~0.7ms each at the measured class; ~55ms per pass at a 79-image worst case) — a lane only on a new trigger

THE ROSTER SCAN OVER A REAL MANY-FILE SESSIONS DIR: the many-sessions class owns it; the image-heavy file contributes ~10.4ms warm per cold scan (the generation-keyed resumable fold re-folds only the grown suffix on re-scans)
outcome: MEASURED + DECOMPOSED; honest negative for the three image-targeting options at the open metric; no merge (measurement-only, no PR); the record + the evidence archive are the deliverable.
decision: Discarded-at-the-open-metric by measurement (all three options); the create-wall class carries the residual as the follow-up question. The fixtures (fx-real deployed in the bench repo; the strip/mid variants in the evidence archive) + the driver + the instrument are reusable for any future image-path lane.
